Hi Elliot — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and two asks so we can lock the eval plan on both sides.

Recap (30 min discovery):
- Main goal: validate Redwood inference latency/cost on Fintegra's document-processing pipeline (20–40 token prompts, 2–3k context)
- Success criteria: median latency < 250ms p99 under 50 concurrent sessions; per-token cost target as discussed
- Primary constraints: SOC2 compliance, VPC-only Private deployment for PII workflows

What I attached:
- Redwood MPA (redwood_mpa_fintegra_2026_v1.pdf) — draft mutual action plan with milestone owners and dates
- Proposed evaluation calendar (fintegra_evaluation_calendar.xlsx) with three 2-week sprints and a final wrap

Two asks: please confirm by EOD next week (Jan 22):
1) Primary evaluation champions on your side (we suggested: Exec sponsor = Elliot Harris, Evaluation lead = Maya Dawson) — if different, please share names and emails.
2) Feasibility of the proposed sprint window (we penciled Feb 2 start; if you need later, tell us preferred week).

If it helps, Marissa (cc'd) can run a short show-and-tell for your infra team to validate VPC/KMS behavior before the sprint.

Thanks — aim is to get the MPA signed and a kickoff on the calendar so your team can move forward without extra context churn.

Best,
